purpose: Callgrind totals of measurement/step.c (organizer image and flags) on two input sets (seeds 1 and 2) at 1, 2, 4, 8, 63 and 64 batch steps of 65536 walks; plain = Ir(2)-Ir(1), anchor = Ir(64)-Ir(63). Inputs: the first 132096 generator lines (2^16 adders, 2^16 walks, 1024 spares).
kernel: step.c with p256_fused.h: batch_step's subtractions, products and square in fused kernels that keep values in registers; rare paths out of line, unchanged
exactness: seed 1, 8 batch steps of 2^16 walks: walk_ref.py check reports 0 mismatches, and the dump and event line are byte-identical to the previous kernel's
compiled_identity: objdump -d of the organizer-flag builds, addresses normalised: every function other than batch_step is instruction-identical to the previous kernel's at ADDER_BITS 16 and 24, so measurement/forced/summary.json applies unchanged; batch_step at 24 differs from 16 only in mask and shift immediates, branch offsets and alignment no-ops, and executes 2 more instructions per batch round (two no-ops before its first loop), which accounting.py adds

common_path_bound.method: disassembly of the organizer-flag build; every conditional branch run once per walk
branches_per_walk: distinguished-point test, one compare of (key>>24)|(x.v[1] & mask) with 0: taken only at a distinguished point (dp_restart, a rare event)
previous-key filter match: rare_2cycle (a rare event)
anchor filter match: rare_anchor (a rare event)
trail cap, anchor rounds only: new_trail (an abandonment, a rare event)
